title: Alliance Entertainment Leads ArtPics Funding Round with Strategic Investment
summary: Investment expands Alliance’s participation in original Fine Art collectibles and builds on ArtPics’s existing use of Endstate Authentic’s NFC authentication technology PLANTATION, Fla., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation (NASDAQ: AENT), a scaled entertainment commerce and collectibles platform serving content owners, brands, retailers and fans across music, movies, gaming, licensed merchandise...
body_markdown:
PLANTATION, Fla., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation (NASDAQ: AENT), a scaled entertainment commerce and collectibles platform serving content owners, brands, retailers and fans across music, movies, gaming, licensed merchandise and collectibles, with proprietary brands, authentication technology and reach across more than 35,000 retail and e-commerce storefronts, today announced a $500,000 strategic investment in ArtPics Inc. as the lead investor in the company’s current funding round. The investment, made through a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE), builds on Alliance’s existing commercial relationship with ArtPics and expands its participation in the market for original Fine Art collectibles.


Founded by collectibles entrepreneur and artist Gareb Shamus, ArtPics brings original Fine Art to the trading-card format. Each card is a unique work created directly by an artist, rather than a print or reproduction, combining the appeal of original art ownership with the accessibility and collectibility of trading cards. ArtPics already incorporates Endstate Authentic’s NFC technology into its original Fine Art trading cards, connecting physical artwork with digital authentication and ownership-related information.


ArtPics recently extended its commercial relationship with Endstate Authentic for an additional two years, reinforcing the companies’ ongoing collaboration in NFC-enabled authentication. Alliance also sees opportunities to support ArtPics’ expansion through its established retail relationships, distribution infrastructure and direct-to-consumer fulfillment capabilities.


“ArtPics brings together two passionate collecting communities: Fine Art and trading cards,” said Jeff Walker, Chief Executive Officer of Alliance Entertainment. “Gareb has a strong understanding of collectors and how to build a business around what they love. What makes this particularly compelling for us is that ArtPics is already using Endstate Authentic’s technology to authenticate these one-of-a-kind works. We are excited to lead this funding round and see opportunities to help ArtPics reach more collectors through Alliance’s relationships and capabilities.”


“We’re incredibly excited for Alliance Entertainment to lead ArtPics’ new funding round,” said Gareb Shamus, Founder and CEO of ArtPics. “We’ve worked closely with Endstate over the past year, integrating their patented NFC technology to help authenticate and protect every original ArtPics Fine Art trading card. As collecting and secondary markets continue to grow worldwide, this technology will play an integral role in the future of collectibles. Together with Alliance and Endstate Authentic, we’re combining original art, the excitement of trading cards, and physical ownership supported by digital authentication and provenance records to create an entirely new collecting experience for fans around the world.”


The strategic investment comes amid continued interest in original art and distinctive collectibles. According to the *Art Basel and UBS Global Art Market Report 2026* , global art sales increased 4% to an estimated $59.6 billion in 2025. A separate 2026 Art Basel and UBS survey found that 43% of surveyed high-net-worth collectors identified uniqueness and rarity as the most important attributes of art ownership. ArtPics’ one-of-one format brings those characteristics to a product designed to appeal to both art collectors and trading-card enthusiasts.


**About ArtPics**


ArtPics brings original Fine Art to the trading-card format, creating a new way for collectors to discover, own and trade one-of-a-kind artwork. Each card features an original work created by an artist, rather than a print or reproduction, and is encapsulated and equipped with NFC-enabled technology that connects the physical artwork to digital authentication and provenance records. Founded by Gareb and Stephen Shamus, ArtPics works with a growing roster of artists to make original fine art more accessible to collectors. Gareb Shamus is the founder of Wizard Entertainment and co-founder of ACE Comic Con, and previously published iconic entertainment and collectibles magazines including *Wizard* , *ToyFare, InQuest Gamer,* and *Anime Insider* .


Learn more at[artpicscards.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=1qQxrIfK6SZ93qXeh62Qg65yBJHp-2DEhml8HeN7R_3VNhmW71puY_2_yNxR2qkRLLQ7DeObNvHpMi29VlLOrugGP9OY-QFLiqSWzoyCauo=) and on Instagram at @artpicscards.


**About Alliance Entertainment**


Alliance Entertainment (NASDAQ: AENT) is a premier distributor and fulfillment partner for the entertainment and pop culture collectibles industry. With more than 340,000 unique in-stock SKUs – including over 57,300 exclusive titles across compact discs, vinyl LPs, DVDs, Blu-rays, and video games – Alliance offers the largest selection of physical media in the market. Our vast catalog also includes licensed merchandise, toys, retro gaming products, and collectibles, serving over 35,000 retail locations and powering e-commerce fulfillment for leading retailers. Alliance also owns and operates proprietary collectibles brands, including Handmade by Robots™, a stylized vinyl figure line featuring licensed characters from leading entertainment franchises, and Alliance Authentic™, a premium platform for authentic, certified, and individually numbered entertainment collectibles. In addition, Alliance operates Endstate Authentic, a dedicated NFC-enabled authentication and digital product identity platform supporting authenticated collectibles, resale, and brand protection. Leveraging decades of operational expertise, exclusive sourcing relationships, and a capital-light, scalable infrastructure, Alliance connects fans and collectors to the products, franchises, and experiences they value across formats and generations. For more information, visit www.aent.com.
